title: ‘Not a gift-giving year’: student loan debt upends US borrowers’ holiday spending

At first glance, someone like Ben L should not be struggling financially. He attended Georgetown University and Columbia University for his undergraduate and graduate degrees, respectively, and now earns a six-figure salary working at a biotech company.
